conflicts.spec1: Instance Invariant Storage for Impulses and Activities
conflicts.description: Both specs persist activity data to backend, but via different endpoints: /v2/activities (Instance Invariant Storage) vs /api/v1/activity-execution/content (State Transformation Tracking)
conflicts.impact: Potential data duplication, increased backend load, unclear source of truth

instanceInvariantStorage.purpose: Store complete activity for cross-instance retrieval
instanceInvariantStorage.payload: Full activity state (status, metrics, tasks, results)

stateTransformationTracking.purpose: Store execution metadata for learning loop
stateTransformationTracking.payload: Template definition, variable bindings, initial state, reason, task sequence

option1.description: Consolidate both payloads into single /v2/activities endpoint with execution_metadata field

option2.description: Keep separate endpoints with well-defined purposes: /v2/activities for instance-invariant storage, /api/v1/activity-execution for learning loop metadata
option2.recommendation: RECOMMENDED - maintain current architecture with clear documentation

option3.description: /v2/activities stores full activity, /api/v1/activity-execution stores reference + additional metadata

conflicts.recommendedAction: Option 2: Maintain current architecture with documentation clarifying: /v2/activities = instance-invariant full activity storage, /api/v1/activity-execution = execution learning metadata
